title: stanleya pinnata
intro: Stanleya pinnata, commonly known as prickly phlox, is a perennial plant native to North America. It has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties that can help alleviate symptoms of fever, rheumatism, and sore throats. The therapeutic actions of Stanleya pinnata include its ability to stimulate digestion, relieve pain, and reduce inflammation due to the presence of bioactive constituents such as flavonoids and saponins. The bioactive constituents of this plant, including flavonoids, saponins, and phenolic acids, contribute to its medicinal properties and have been shown to exhibit antimicrobial and antihyperglycemic activities.
